reference: Model Context Protocol. Understanding MCP servers.
principal_finding: Separates tools, resources and prompts by semantics and control; prompts are reusable templates, resources provide context and tools execute typed actions.
limitation: Protocol semantics do not prescribe the ARA product model or prove educational value.
ara_implication: Model prompts, knowledge/resources and operations as distinct discoverable objects.

reference: Model Context Protocol. Server overview, revision 2025-06-18.
principal_finding: Defines prompts, resources and tools as first-class server primitives with different control models.
limitation: Specification-level evidence only.
ara_implication: Use MCP semantics as technical input while preserving provider-neutral domain concepts.

reference: Model Context Protocol. Resources.
principal_finding: Resources can be directly selected, searched, filtered or automatically included by application heuristics/model selection.
limitation: Does not solve retrieval quality, privacy or educational context selection.
ara_implication: Support versioned knowledge collections and explicit context policies.

reference: Model Context Protocol. Prompts.
principal_finding: Prompt templates are discoverable, parameterized and user-controlled.
limitation: User-control model may require adaptation for ARA administrative profiles.
ara_implication: Represent domain/task templates as versioned objects rather than hard-coded monoliths.

reference: Sahoo et al. A Systematic Survey of Prompt Engineering in Large Language Models: Techniques and Applications.
principal_finding: Prompting techniques are task-dependent and constitute a broad design space without changing model weights.
limitation: Rapidly evolving field; survey predates newer agent workflows.
ara_implication: Avoid one universal prompt; preserve profiles, tasks, examples and evaluation history.

reference: Korn et al. Reporting LLM Prompting in Automated Software Engineering: A Guideline Based on Current Practices and Expectations.
principal_finding: Analysis of nearly 300 papers and survey of 105 reviewers finds poor reporting of prompt design, version and justification, harming reproducibility.
limitation: Software-engineering context and preprint status.
ara_implication: Persist exact prompt/profile versions, rationale, models and threats to validity for ARA operations and studies.

reference: Siddiq et al. Large Language Models for Software Engineering: A Reproducibility Crisis.
principal_finding: Study of 640 papers reports persistent gaps in data, environment, model and versioning documentation.
limitation: Software-engineering research; preprint.
ara_implication: Treat prompt, knowledge, model, tools, environment and dataset as one reproducibility snapshot.

reference: OpenAI. How evals drive the next chapter of AI for businesses.
principal_finding: Frames evaluation as specify, measure and improve using real-world cases.
limitation: Provider guidance, not peer-reviewed educational evidence.
ara_implication: Create task/domain eval suites and regression corpora before activating profile revisions.

reference: OpenAI. A shared playbook for trustworthy third-party evaluations.
principal_finding: Agent performance depends on model, tools, workflow and environment, not model identity alone.
limitation: Focused on frontier-model evaluation.
ara_implication: Evaluate complete ARA agent configurations and workflows, not only prompts or models.

reference: Li et al. Retrieval-augmented generation for educational application: A systematic survey.
principal_finding: RAG can improve factual grounding and dynamic knowledge updates in education while introducing retrieval and knowledge-base quality concerns.
limitation: Heterogeneous applications; effectiveness cannot be inferred from architecture.
ara_implication: Use versioned knowledge collections, retrieval evaluation and provenance by domain.

reference: Sharma et al. Retrieval Augmented Generation for Domain-specific Question Answering.
principal_finding: Domain-specific retriever adaptation improves final generation and reduces hallucination in a product QA context.
limitation: Non-educational domain and in-house system.
ara_implication: Investigate domain retrieval profiles rather than separate monolithic GPTs.

reference: Siriwardhana et al. Improving the Domain Adaptation of Retrieval Augmented Generation Models.
principal_finding: Joint adaptation of retriever and generator improves domain-specific QA on multiple domains.
limitation: Requires training and may not transfer directly to API-based agents.
ara_implication: Separate domain knowledge/retrieval configuration from prompt templates and provider choice.

reference: Nguyen. Towards Personalized AI Education: Context-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Generation With Grade-Level LLM Adaptation.
principal_finding: Context-aware retrieval and proficiency adaptation address heterogeneous learner needs.
limitation: Single application/domain; personalization claims require bounded transfer.
ara_implication: Profiles may combine domain, audience and pedagogical context without changing kernel semantics.

reference: Hua et al. Proactive framework for evaluating retrieval-augmented generation-based learning assistants in engineering education.
principal_finding: Historical learner questions and coverage measures can expose retrieval and response failure patterns.
limitation: Engineering education case and framework-specific metrics.
ara_implication: Build query corpora and evaluate retrieval separately from generated answer quality.

reference: Large language models in education: a systematic review of empirical applications, benefits, and challenges.
principal_finding: Review of 88 empirical studies identifies benefits alongside over-reliance, fairness, privacy and technical reliability concerns.
limitation: Fast-moving evidence and heterogeneous designs.
ara_implication: Keep human authority, protocol-specific evaluation and explicit limitations.

reference: Misiejuk et al. Mapping the Landscape of Generative Artificial Intelligence in Learning Analytics.
principal_finding: Review of 41 papers finds GenAI mostly used for discourse coding, scoring and classification, with an emerging role across the LA cycle.
limitation: Young evidence base and limited mature deployments.
ara_implication: Separate analytic task, authority, validation and pedagogical interpretation.

reference: Alfredo et al. Human-centred learning analytics and AI in education.
principal_finding: Review of 108 papers finds limited end-user involvement and recommends balancing human control, automation, safety, reliability and trustworthiness.
limitation: Human-centred practice is inconsistently operationalized.
ara_implication: Make user contribution, contestation, approval and visibility first-class requirements.

reference: Tuhkala. A systematic literature review of participatory design studies involving teachers.
principal_finding: Participatory design can involve teachers in educational technology design but practices and outcomes vary.
limitation: Predates current GenAI systems and focuses on teachers.
ara_implication: Treat contributors as stakeholders with explicit roles; do not equate participation with majority voting.

reference: Paulsen and Lindsay. Learning analytics dashboards are increasingly becoming about learning and not just analytics.
principal_finding: Student-facing dashboards increasingly connect analytics to learning design rather than presenting data alone.
limitation: Dashboard-specific; does not validate every analytic intervention.
ara_implication: Organize ARA analytics by questions, decisions, explanations and limits rather than generic charts.

reference: Goyanes, Lopezosa and Jordá. Thematic analysis of interview data with ChatGPT: designing and testing a reliable research protocol.
principal_finding: Structured protocols can make LLM-assisted thematic analysis more transparent and testable.
limitation: One methodological setup; human interpretation remains necessary.
ara_implication: Version prompts, corpus, coding procedure, model and review rubric for qualitative analytics.

reference: Evaluation of large language models within GenAI in qualitative research.
principal_finding: GPT-4o supported rapid themes and checks but did not match experienced human thematic analysis due to hallucination, context and reflexivity limitations.
limitation: One health-research dataset and model configuration.
ara_implication: Use LLM as analyst assistant/check, preserve quotes, provenance, reflexivity and human decision.

reference: Parfenova, Denzler and Pfeffer. Automating Qualitative Data Analysis with Large Language Models.
principal_finding: Maps limits of automated thematic coding and highlights researcher bias and methodological gaps.
limitation: Proposal rather than completed validation.
ara_implication: Maintain a focused evidence programme before claiming automated qualitative validity.

reference: Martinez Montes et al. Large Language Models in Thematic Analysis: Prompt Engineering, Evaluation, and Guidelines.
principal_finding: Expert evaluation found LLM codes useful but noted fragmentation, missed latent interpretation and unclear theme boundaries.
limitation: Preprint and software-engineering dataset.
ara_implication: Expose multiple runs, code/theme boundaries, disagreements and human review.

reference: Leça et al. Applications and Implications of Large Language Models in Qualitative Analysis.
principal_finding: Mapping of 21 studies reports efficiency benefits but variability, nuance, privacy and transparency limitations.
limitation: Preprint and focus on empirical software engineering.
ara_implication: Use structured guidelines, data boundaries and explicit analyst responsibility.

reference: Liu et al. Are LLMs Capable of Data-based Statistical and Causal Reasoning?
principal_finding: QRData benchmark shows the strongest evaluated model at 58% and substantial difficulty combining data with statistical/causal knowledge.
limitation: Benchmark tasks do not cover full research workflows.
ara_implication: Never treat natural-language analysis as authoritative; execute and verify code, assumptions and calculations.

reference: Song et al. StatLLM: A Dataset for Evaluating Large Language Models in Statistical Analysis.
principal_finding: Introduces human-scored statistical tasks and generated SAS code to evaluate correctness, executability and output accuracy.
limitation: Preprint; SAS-focused benchmark.
ara_implication: Create ARA research-analysis fixtures with verified code and outputs across planned methods.

reference: Shyr et al. A statistical framework for evaluating repeatability and reproducibility of large language models.
principal_finding: Output consistency varies by dataset, model and prompting strategy; semantic repeatability and reproducibility require measurement.
limitation: Medical domain and preprint status.
ara_implication: Repeat material analyses and record run/model/configuration variability before relying on conclusions.

reference: Gonzalez et al. LLM-assisted sentiment analysis for integrated computational and qualitative mixed methods education research.
principal_finding: Combines statistical comparison and qualitative examination of student reflections to explore subgroup differences.
limitation: Preprint, one longitudinal study and sentiment-specific workflow.
ara_implication: Support explicit mixed-method integration while preserving units, variables, evidence and human interpretation.

reference: Wang et al. SciBench: Evaluating College-Level Scientific Problem-Solving Abilities of Large Language Models.
principal_finding: Current LLMs perform poorly on complex college-level scientific problems despite prompting variants.
limitation: Problem-solving benchmark rather than research analysis.
ara_implication: Keep domain-specific evals and prohibit claims of general scientific authority.

reference: Autio et al. NIST AI 600-1: Generative Artificial Intelligence Profile.
principal_finding: Provides lifecycle risk-management actions for trustworthy GenAI design, use and evaluation.
limitation: Cross-sector guidance; requires contextualization for education and Brazilian/European settings.
ara_implication: Map risks, actors, measurements, provenance and incident handling to agent profiles and analytics.

reference: UNESCO. Guidance for generative AI in education and research.
principal_finding: Recommends human-centred, privacy-protecting and pedagogically validated uses of GenAI in education and research.
limitation: High-level guidance, not an implementation specification.
ara_implication: Preserve human agency, institutional review, data protection and AI literacy in all analytic modes.

reference: Amo-Filva et al. Exploring the landscape of learning analytics privacy in fog and edge computing.
principal_finding: Edge/fog architectures can reduce centralization and support privacy, but require security and policy design.
limitation: Architecture-specific and not focused on LLM agents.
ara_implication: Keep local/segregated analytics and provider data boundaries as deployment concerns.

reference: Decoding AI ethics from users' lens in education: A systematic review.
principal_finding: Review identifies gaps between formal AIED ethics frameworks and concerns experienced by users.
limitation: Only 17 empirical articles through mid-2023.
ara_implication: Collect and preserve user concerns as governance evidence rather than treating policy as sufficient.

reference: 1EdTech. Caliper Analytics specification and metric profiles.
principal_finding: Provides event vocabularies for educational activities across assessment, annotation, feedback, reading and resource management.
limitation: Event interoperability does not define ARA measures, constructs or consent.
ara_implication: Use standards only as mappings after purpose, protocol and semantics are defined.
